images.label: U01
images.notes: Multi-view tablet. Main face worn in upper section; lower part has shorter repeated wedge groups and near-horizontal separators. Opposite face partly smooth. Modern inventory ink excluded.

images.label: U02
images.notes: Main face shows repeated elongated wedge traces and stacks; horizontal separators clearer than individual sign boundaries. Back mostly smooth with a short inscribed upper portion.

images.label: U03
images.notes: Weathered, dark-speckled surface with many indistinct contacts; good negative readability control, not evidence of absent signs.

images.label: U04
images.notes: Best preserved development image. Repeated stacked-horizontal-plus-standing-trace configurations near bottom of main face and possible related form near lower opposite face. Curved/fan-like internally hatched groups also recur, but exact contour closure uncertain.

token_reviews.observations: Three approximately horizontal traces and steep right-hand stroke appear together; no full-height field rule at this position.
Similar three-trace arrangement beside a steep stroke. Similarity supports keeping full configuration as candidate, not splitting automatically.
Crop includes neighbouring marks; some corresponding traces are obscured. No exact three-trace count asserted.
Near-parallel interior traces inside curved/angular fan-like perimeter; count and contour contacts uncertain.
Related hatch/curve shape, close to separate right-hand traces; alternative boundary retained.
Short stack without same obvious enclosing perimeter; retained as control rather than forced P1/P2 identity.
